name: NeuroSurge
model_scope: Separate model under development; no trained decoder is supplied or validated by this game.
signal_origin: simulated, unitless brain and muscle activity values
source_lineage: Pointer-release and gesture-cancellation repair on the control-update edition. Anatomy assets and the movement model are unchanged. A self-contained software controls suite is included.
anatomy_assets: 490 human-anatomy OBJ files retained. BodyParts3D is CC BY 4.0; Z-Anatomy facial derivatives are CC BY-SA 4.0. Runtime transforms, deformation, colouring, shading and separated layers are display changes, not physiological validation.
code_licence: Project-owned contributions: CC0-1.0. Third-party material retains its own licences and notices.
known_engineering_gaps: Release coalescing can substitute an unstamped safety release, changing original event timing/order.
The waiting-input queue retains its first 64 events and can lose a later release.
Late model/scene/output/render failures can leave state and display out of step.
Pausing between updates can leave fresh or deferred events to replay. Other missing-input browser cases remain unqualified.
Camera rollback evidence covers the whole-arm route only; natural failure branches remain untested.
Near/far endpoints, diagonal carrying, full-arm borders and the upper-quarter hand anchor need broader current checks.
Muscle surfaces remain splotchy/jagged; body/brain layout is crowded and a slow-render notice remains.
A prior composition failed at 375 × 667 and was crowded at 390 × 844; neither observation certifies this package. Portrait and touch use are not checked for this package.
Right upper-arm turn, hip activity colours, shoulder-girdle mechanics and functional registration remain incomplete or unvalidated.
Arrow visibility, clearance, pixel stability and all-view coverage remain incomplete.
Hardware frame rates, other browsers, native Windows/macOS opening, updated Linux launcher target execution, touch, screen readers and reduced motion remain unverified.
Exact pulse/startup/input-to-display timing, comparison with a series of real references, normal joint mechanics, tests on unseen functional data and complete output/export checks remain unfinished.
launcher_scope: Online URL launchers for Windows, macOS and Linux. Formats checked; native Windows/macOS use unverified. Prior Linux installation/launch does not prove execution of this updated target.
publication_status: Experimental preview package. Check the displayed online version before assuming it matches these files.

previous_control_build_verification.scope: One desktop Chromium ordinary-control check of the merged control build; seven sampled states running, no reported error, current calculated-state readbacks. No full input sequence, GPU/pixel timing or every-control acceptance.
previous_control_build_verification.arrows: Two ordinary right-arrow clicks changed the brain transform while all four recorded nominal CPU arrow anchors and the brain centre stayed exact in that case. Not GPU-buffer, pixel, every-arrow or all-view proof.

browser_verification.status: bounded ordinary desktop Chromium check of this pointer-release package
browser_verification.observations: All ten sampled states remained running with no reported error. Two arrow presses had successive button sequence values 1 and 2, and both released. Space stayed held through an ordinary buttonless mouse movement, then released. Esc pause/resume and both E transitions were observed.

software_verification.scope: In-memory event records through the full public controls factory; no browser, rendered pixels or biological validation. Optional API variants are source-reviewed only.
